title: A value with an extractor question saves on the web but starts unticked on the phone
evidence: Done 2026-11-27 (root fix R23 closed, superseded by the shared upload engine): one engine rule sets the default ticks for both clients. packages/health-core/src/upload-review.ts:96-112 (importFile: every value starts ticked, one the extractor asked about included, on both clients; the person's ticks win); pinned by packages/health-core/src/upload-view.rulings.test.ts:32-42 (web and phone both save the asked value unless cleared). The two old rules are deleted: widget-src/src/lib/review-matrix.ts in b3bc39b51 (PR 1972, 2026-11-22) and ios/HealthRoadmap/LabUpload/LabReportSave.swift in 7f1fb856c (PR 1913, 2026-11-20). Was: web review-matrix.ts:292-296 prefilled it; phone LabReportSave.swift:30 unticked it (US-52 AC8). Found during save-all (US-52 AC8b), Fable 2026-11-11
